## s16-v01 — argument map

Nothing of folk stands against Thy veiling (na kiñcid eva lokānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati). Nothing of devotees stands against it either (na kiñcid eva bhaktānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati). The two lines are identical in form; only lokānāṃ/bhaktānāṃ changes.

### Open
- GRETIL carries a \var alternate first quarter (yat kiṃ cid eva bhūtānāṃ) with a Nareśvaraparīkṣā cross-ref; cite cleaned to the main reading, variant logged here.
- Whether the verse consoles (nothing you must fight) or accuses (not even devotion avails) is unresolved.
